sponsored.t: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund for any loss, claim, action or judgment for which such school district is authorized or required to purchase or maintain insurance for the kinds of risks for which insurance is authorized.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the county of Wyoming, constituting state route 98 from School Street in the town of Sheldon at the southern end to the southern line of the village of Attica, to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger.

sponsored.t: Authorizes non-resident volunteer membership within the East Concord Fire Department, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Exempts the East Concord Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to 2LT Edward Dixon Neal
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 20A in the county of Wyoming to 2LT Edward Dixon Neal.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing enhanced attendance verification procedures for members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative members to verify attendance on legislative session days via an identification card system and facial recognition technology.

sponsored.t: Relates to the school supplies education credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the school supplies education credit to allow a resident taxpayer who is a parent, guardian or other person, lawfully having the care, custody or control of a person who has not yet attained the age of nineteen years, and such person is enrolled in elementary or secondary education in any public school, nonpublic or charter school, board of cooperative educational services, or that receives home instruction, to have a credit equal to the cost of learning materials and school supplies purchased for education purposes during the taxable year, provided that such credit shall not exceed five hundred dollars per student and shall not exceed the total one thousand five hundred dollars…

sponsored.t: Relates to certain conduct that may place a person in segregated confinement
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain conduct that may place a person in segregated confinement; expands the criteria that can be used for calculating good behavior allowances.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the release of certain chemical compounds into the atmosphere in this state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the intentional injection, release or dispersion, by any means, of chemicals, chemical compounds, substances or apparatus within the borders of this state into the atmosphere with the express purpose of affecting temperature, weather or the intensity of sunlight; provides the department will establish a reporting process for violations; provides penalties for such violations.

sponsored.t: Defines the terms "person", "human", and "human being" in the state constitution
sponsored.sum: Defines the terms "person", "human", and "human being" to mean a member of the species homo sapiens at any stage of biological development beginning at the moment of fertilization regardless of age, health, level of functioning, or condition of dependency; requires the right to life of all human beings.

sponsored.t: Proposes a constitutional amendment to divide the state into three autonomous regions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Proposes a constitutional amendment to divide the state into three autonomous regions; the New Amsterdam Region, the New York Region and the Montauk Region; provides regional governors and regional legislators; provides only for a state sales tax; divides various departments and agencies; provides for separate court systems and prison systems.

sponsored.t: Establishes the position of member of the legislature as a part-time, volunteer position in the service of the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes the position of member of the legislature as a part-time, volunteer position in the service of the state; provides that state legislators shall receive no salary, or any other compensation or benefit from the state; authorizes the payment of travel expenses and per diem for days the legislature is in session, provides that per diem is limited to 30 days per annum; provides that the legislature shall convene in regular session only on Saturdays and Sundays in January and February; accelerates the state budget process so that the state budget is enacted on or before the last Sunday of February each year.

sponsored.t: Relates to a religious exemption from vaccination requirements
sponsored.sum: Provides a religious exemption from vaccination requirements for school attendance.

sponsored.t: Requires health care providers and practitioners to provide patients with a list of ingredients contained in vaccines
sponsored.sum: Requires health care providers and practitioners to provide patients with a list of ingredients contained in vaccines, the manufacturer product insert, the vaccines' potential side effects and where to report vaccine-adverse events forty-eight hours prior to immunization.

sponsored.t: Requires recipients of public assistance benefits submit to pre-qualification drug screening and testing, random drug testing, reasonable suspicion drug testing and resumption of benefits drug testing
sponsored.sum: Requires recipients of public assistance benefits submit to pre-qualification drug screening and testing, random drug testing, reasonable suspicion drug testing and resumption of benefits drug testing.

sponsored.t: Allows persons in parental relation to a child to choose to immunize such child; repealer
sponsored.sum: Allows persons in parental relation to a child to choose to immunize such child and requires a person to submit a form to such child's school when such person wishes not to administer an immunization to such child.

sponsored.t: Requires forfeiture of certain property by certain persons convicted of sexual performance of child offenses
sponsored.sum: Permits civil forfeiture action to recover property used in or proceeds derived from criminal activity relating to sexual performances by a child; directs proceeds be used by local social services offices for the prevention and treatment of sexual abuses against children.

sponsored.t: Relates to the personal income tax levy by New York state
sponsored.sum: Places a limit on the personal income tax levy by New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the filing of approved applications for licenses for the possession of firearms
sponsored.sum: Provides for the confidentiality of applications for licenses for the possession of firearms.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a fishing license exemption for disabled persons that do not live in a group home
sponsored.sum: Provides a fishing license exemption for disabled persons that do not live in a group home.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Eden, county of Erie to discontinue as parklands and alienate certain lands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Eden, county of Erie, to discontinue as parklands and alienate certain lands for the purpose of providing needed resources to the existing parks within such town.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to persons who are active or reserve members of the armed forces or the organized militia, and to certain veterans thereof
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to persons who are active or reserve members of the armed forces or the organized militia, and to honorably discharged veterans thereof who have ten or more years of military service.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding for the office for people with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to funding for the office for people with developmental disabilities; transfers one billion dollars to such office from funds appropriated to the MTA; appropriates funds therefor.

sponsored.t: Repeals chapter 1 of the laws of 2013, amending the criminal procedure law and other laws relating to suspension and revocation of firearms licenses; private sale or disposal of firearms, rifles or shotguns
sponsored.sum: Relates to suspension and revocation of firearms licenses; relates to private sale or disposal of firearms, rifles or shotguns; establishes a minimum age to possess a firearm relating to gun control.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices from certain requirements of the penal law
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain large capacity ammunition feeding devices from certain requirements of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Relates to taking big and small game by crossbow in Wyoming county
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to authorize the use of a crossbow for the taking of big and small game by any licensed person for use during the entirety of the archery-only season within Wyoming county.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the location of wind turbines on Lake Erie
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the location and construction of wind turbines on Lake Erie.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state officers and employees from using state aircraft for political purposes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a statewide elected official, state officer or employee, member of the legislature or legislative employee to use state aircraft for political purposes; provides a violation of such restriction constitutes a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the justified use of physical force
sponsored.sum: Relates to the justified use of physical force; removes requirement that a person facing an imminent physical threat must retreat; provides immunity from civil and criminal liability.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for affidavit ballots and absentee ballots
sponsored.sum: Requires voters voting by affidavit ballot to produce an identification document to verify residency in the election district; requires absentee ballots to be received by election day, or be post-marked by the first day of early voting.

sponsored.t: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service
sponsored.sum: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service.

sponsored.t: Imposes a one year residency requirement for eligibility for medical assistance
sponsored.sum: Imposes a one year residency requirement for eligibility for medical assistance; authorizes the commissioner of health to promulgate any and all rules and regulations and take any other measures necessary to implement this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to a "Campaign Medal for Service" to be awarded to those who have provided military service in Iraq
sponsored.sum: Provides for the "Campaign Medal for Service" to be awarded to those who have provided military service in Iraq.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the carrying of firearms by military personnel at recruiting centers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the carrying of service-issued firearms by military personnel at recruiting centers while on duty.

sponsored.t: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt
sponsored.sum: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt; requires refund of all fees submitted with such application if a determination is not made in a timely manner.

sponsored.t: Ensures that women seeking an abortion receive an ultrasound and the opportunity to review the ultrasound before giving informed consent to receive an abortion
sponsored.sum: Ensures that women seeking an abortion receive an ultrasound and the opportunity to review the ultrasound before giving informed consent to receive an abortion.

sponsored.t: Provides free hunting, fishing, and trapping licenses for volunteer instructors
sponsored.sum: Provides free hunting, fishing, and trapping licenses for qualified volunteer instructors.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to nursing home residents by essential caregivers
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to nursing home residents by essential caregivers; establishes safety protocols and appeals processes.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding for highway construction and improvements
sponsored.sum: Relates to funding for highway construction and improvements in New York state from funds appropriated to the MTA; appropriates funds therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding for the state office for the aging; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Appropriates $400 million for the state office for the aging.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting mandatory COVID-19 vaccination and enacts a vaccine bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mandatory COVID-19 vaccination; limits civil liability of employers; prohibits requiring vaccination for education, employment, travel or other activities; enacts a vaccine bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to a distinctive plate for active duty military service members
sponsored.sum: Permits a distinctive plate for active duty military service members.

sponsored.t: Relates to a real property tax exemption for property owned by active duty service members
sponsored.sum: Provides a real property tax exemption for property owned by active duty service members of the armed forces of the United States in taxing jurisdictions which elect to provide a veterans exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recertification process for firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to the recertification process for firearms.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting active duty military members free use of state parks and campsites
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Grants active duty military members free use of state parks, campsites and other public places of recreation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of unlawful tampering of the milk supply in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of unlawful tampering of the milk supply in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing certain free permits, stamps and privileges for qualified hunting instructors
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a free bowhunting privilege, muzzle-loading privilege, turkey permit, duck stamp, and doe permit for qualified hunting instructors.

sponsored.t: Relates to desecration of property commemorating a historical figure
sponsored.sum: Makes desecration of property commemorating a historical figure a class C felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting private and parochial schools and day care centers from immunization requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts private and parochial schools and day care centers from immunization requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to training of school personnel in non-lethal defense skills
sponsored.sum: Adds training of school personnel in non-lethal defense skills to requirements for school safety plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of an assault weapon
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of an assault weapon.

sponsored.t: Establishes strict liability for injuries caused by required immunizations
sponsored.sum: Establishes a claim for strict liability against the state for any injury caused by the administration of an immunization which is mandated by a state law; gives the court of claims the power and jurisdiction to hear such a claim.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing one license plate to be issued for a vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing, for a fee, one license plate to be issued and displayed on the rear of a vehicle; directs funds gathered to be deposited in the New York state wireless telephone emergency account.

sponsored.t: Makes permanent the provisions of chapter 396 of the laws of 2012, amending the education law, relating to services to out-of-state school districts by boards of cooperative educational services
sponsored.sum: Makes permanent the provisions relating to services to out-of-state school districts by boards of cooperative educational services.

sponsored.t: Permits concealed carry at state rest and parking areas and scenic overlooks
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of transportation shall not prohibit concealed carry firearms at state rest and parking areas and scenic overlooks by persons with a valid permit to carry concealed.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents
sponsored.sum: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the prohibition on firearm silencers
sponsored.sum: Provides that dental insurance coverage shall include coverage for night guards; defines dental night guards; provides that dental night guards shall be covered under Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier 1 status in the New York teachers' retirement system to James J. DeMarco
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier 1 status in the New York state teachers' retirement system to James J. DeMarco.

sponsored.t: Allows the opt-out of sewer districts under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides that at the request of an owner of a parcel of property within the boundaries of such sewer district requests exclusion from the sewer district due to the lack of sewage services provided to such parcel of property, such request shall be granted without the state department of health approval and without the procedure set forth in section 256 of the county law.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding for the local street and highway improvement program
sponsored.sum: Relates to funding for the local street and highway improvement program.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to LCpl. Joseph Bailey
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 39 in the county of Wyoming to LCpl. Joseph Bailey.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Corporal Kermit Davis
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 39 in the county of Wyoming to Corporal Kermit Davis.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the life appropriation act prohibiting funding for abortion and related costs and prohibiting dismemberment abortions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "life appropriation act" prohibiting state funding for abortions and related costs; regulates abortions and prohibits dismemberment abortions.

sponsored.t: Makes English the official language of New York state
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state English language empowerment act which deems English the official language of the government of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Provides for the elimination of tolls on the New York state thruway for vehicles transporting veterans to and from veteran's administration hospitals and other veteran's healthcare facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for the elimination of tolls on the New York state thruway for vehicles transporting veterans to and from veteran's administration hospitals and other veteran's healthcare facilities.

sponsored.t: Increases the crime victim assistance fee, creates a crime victim's lien and creates a crime victim's assistance account
sponsored.sum: Increases the mandatory surcharge and the crime victim's assistance fee which is levied upon any person convicted of a crime or violation in this state; creates a crime victim's lien which allows such recovery against a convicted offender in the amount of the unpaid portion of the mandatory surcharge or the crime victim's assistance fee; creates a crime victim's assistance account.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing Bible literacy courses in public schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing Bible literacy courses in public schools; directs the commissioner to promulgate regulations establishing an elective course of studies in Hebrew scriptures and the New Testament of the Bible to teach students knowledge of biblical content, characters, poetry, and narratives that are prerequisites to understanding contemporary society and culture, including literature, art, music, mores, oratory, and public policy.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the release of personal medical records or information without a warrant or express written authorization of the individual
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the release of personal medical records or information without a warrant or express written authorization of the individual; prohibits the condition of the consent of release for an application for a firearms license.

sponsored.t: Requires pharmaceutical drug manufacturers and wholesalers to annually disclose all gifts to certain health care practitioners
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state pharmaceutical drug manufacturer and wholesaler disclosure act; requires pharmaceutical drug manufacturers and wholesalers to annually report to the New York department of health, for disclosure to the general public, all of its gifts to health care practitioners that prescribe drugs when such gifts have a value of seventy-five dollars or more; authorizes the commissioner of health to impose penalties and promulgate necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Creates the offense of unlawful funeral protest
sponsored.sum: Makes it unlawful to engage protest activities within one thousand feet of any location at which a funeral is being held.

sponsored.t: Authorizes medical testing of incarcerated persons upon application for certain privileges for infection with certain diseases
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the medical testing for infection with the AIDS virus of certain incarcerated individuals applying for certain privileges such as marriage, temporary release program, and family reunions; authorizes the disclosure of such test results for such purposes; authorizes the notification of correctional personnel of incarcerated individuals having symptoms of AIDS; authorizes commissioner to deny access of the incarcerated individual to such privileges if they test positive.

sponsored.t: Establishes a veterans' dental insurance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a veterans' dental insurance program through the department of civil service; appropriates funds.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to LTJG Brock Wendel Yates
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 19 in the county of Wyoming to LTJG Brock Wendel Yates.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the maximum age limit for firearms instruction exemptions
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the maximum age limit for firearms instruction exemptions; removes upper age limits of sixteen and twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Boston NY Fallen Firefighters
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Boston NY Fallen Firefighters.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from November 30, 2025 to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Maintenance Supervisor Stephen C. Ebling
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Eden, county of Erie, to Maintenance Supervisor Stephen C. Ebling.
